description:
Capture real gameplay frames (HUD included) from a hidden game window, no editor needed; game flags and player steps get past the title screen. Returns each frame's path and size: look at them before use.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/capture-gameplay"}

args.description: The game's own command-line flags, passed after "--" (OS.get_cmdline_user_args()), e.g. ["--autostart", "--solo"] to skip the title screen.

out.description: Output folder. Defaults to <project>/.summer/captures/<time>/ (ignored by git).

project.description: Project folder with project.godot. Defaults to the MCP's bound project, then the working directory.

scene.description: Scene to start (res://... or uid://...). Default: the project's main scene, which is often a title menu; pass the gameplay scene for gameplay frames.

steps.description: What to do after waitSeconds, in order; exactly one of press, key, action, click, drag, wait, shot per step.

action.description: Press an input action from the project's InputMap, e.g. jump.

click.description: Left-click at [x, y] in frame pixels.

drag.description: Drag with the left button from [x, y] to [x, y] over ms (default 300).

holdMs.description: How long key or action is held (default 100).

key.description: Press a key by Godot name: Space, Enter, Escape, A, Up.

press.description: Press the visible button with this text (or node name); waits up to timeoutSeconds (default 10) for it.

waitSeconds.description: Seconds the game runs before the first frame (default 3).

name: summer_capture_gameplay
title: Capture gameplay screenshots
